recipe: frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14 with 4 register tokens, temporally self-supervised on the pre-cleavage window; 3-seed 256x2 distributional head, no TTA
outputIs: log(mean posterior) -- softmax recovers the posterior exactly
unit: hours until first cleavage; from the corpus' own per-frame clock (Gomez timeElapsed), no assumed frame interval
valProtocol: 6-fold grouped CV over patient-slide components, 3 seeds, sealed vault folded in
partsNote: Stored as 3 consecutive byte-range parts because wrangler refuses objects over 300 MiB. Concatenating part0..part2 in order reproduces the file byte for byte; `sha256` is the checksum of the reassembled whole.
heldOutNote: NO held-out estimate exists. The sealed vault was deliberately folded into training on 2026-08-24, so every figure here is cross-validation.
intervalNote: The page draws the narrowest span holding `intervalMass` of the posterior; that span was measured out-of-fold over all 66,573 frames to contain the true time `intervalCoverage` of the time. Re-measured for THIS trunk rather than carried over: the raw 80%-mass span covers only 29.1%, because a distributional head trained on soft targets is over-confident. 90% is not reachable this way.
trunkProvenance: Initialised from the sibling MOUSE project's self-supervised trunk (E:/VisionModel cache/ssl_vitl, plain ViT-L/14, 6,000 delta-t steps on mouse zygotes), ported into this project's reg4 architecture: 303,226,880 of 303,230,976 parameters (99.9986%). Only the 4 register tokens are new -- the mouse architecture has none -- and pos_embed was remapped 257->256 by dropping the class position, which reg4 does not use. Then 96,000 human delta-t steps, the same budget as the previous champion. The mouse initialisation measurably contributed NOTHING: cold on human embryos it scored 4.474 h against stock DINOv2's 4.320 h, it trained BEHIND the stock-initialised run until ~step 60,000, and the two finished level.
ttaNote: TTA-8 measured -0.001 h on the previous trunk of this recipe; off.
sigmaNote: sigma 0.25. Chosen on the per-band table, not the overall number: 0-1 h MAE 0.627 h here against 0.943 at sigma 1.0.
